mapping={name:name.removeprefix('Reinsirk').removeprefix('reinsirk_')for name in json.loads((p/'inventory.json').read_text())if not name.startswith('REINSIRK_')}
files={
 'Algorithm/LIS.cpp':([],['LISLengths']),

}

for name,(guards,partials)in files.items():
 f=r/name;s=f.read_text();old=s;snap=p/'root_snapshot'/name;snap.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True);snap.write_text(s)
 used={x:y for x,y in mapping.items()if re.search(r'\b'+re.escape(x)+r'\b',s)}
 pat=re.compile(r'\b('+'|'.join(map(re.escape,used))+r')\b');s=pat.sub(lambda m:'reinsirk::detail::'+used[m[0]],s)
 # Namespace boundaries follow existing guards, leaving headers outside.
 for guard in guards:
  start=s.index('#define '+guard+'\n')+len('#define '+guard+'\n');end=None;depth=1
  for match in re.finditer(r'^\s*#\s*(if|ifdef|ifndef|endif)\b.*$',s[start:],re.M):
   if match[1]=='endif':depth-=1
   else:depth+=1
   if depth==0:end=start+match.start();break
  assert end is not None
  body=s[start:end].replace('reinsirk::detail::','')
  s=s[:start]+'namespace reinsirk::detail {\n'+body+'} // namespace reinsirk::detail\n'+s[end:]
 for func in partials:
  marker='reinsirk::detail::'+func;pos=s.index(marker);start=s.rindex('template <',0,pos);end=s.index('\n}\n',pos)+3

 # Preserve every directive line verbatim, not just macro names.
 directives=lambda text:re.findall(r'^\s*#.*$',text,re.M)
 assert directives(s)==directives(old),name
 # Inverse transformation must recover exact pre-change text.
 restored=s.replace('namespace reinsirk::detail {\n','').replace('} // namespace reinsirk::detail\n','').replace('reinsirk::detail::','')
 reverse={y:x for x,y in used.items()};restored=re.sub(r'\b('+'|'.join(map(re.escape,reverse))+r')\b',lambda m:reverse[m[0]],restored)
 assert restored==old,name

import re,json,hashlib
root=Path('/home/reinsirk/Atcoder_Env/Graph')
out=Path('/tmp/atcoder_symbol_names_20261020/graph')
configs={
'Bellman-Ford.cpp':('REINSIRK_BELLMAN_FORD_DEFINED','inline bool BellmanFord(', ['ReinsirkBellmanFordContinue','ReinsirkBellmanFordImpl','ReinsirkBellmanFordSparse','ReinsirkBellmanFordForward']),
'Bellman-Ford_SFPA.cpp':('REINSIRK_SPFA_DEFINED','inline bool SPFA(',['ReinsirkSPFARun']),
'Dijkstra.cpp':('REINSIRK_DIJKSTRA_DEFINED','// 全頂点の最短距離を上書きする。',['ReinsirkDijkstraRadixRun','ReinsirkDijkstraRadixFinish','ReinsirkDijkstraBigImpl','ReinsirkDijkstraLarge','DijkstraRadixHeap','DijkstraImpl']),
'Floyd-Warshall.cpp':('REINSIRK_FLOYD_WARSHALL_DEFINED','inline bool FloydWarshall(',['ReinsirkFloydWarshallWide','ReinsirkFloydWarshallLimit','ReinsirkFloydWarshallRun','ReinsirkFloydWarshallImpl']),
'Topological.cpp':('REINSIRK_TOPOLOGICAL_CORE_DEFINED',None,['ReinsirkTopologicalRun']),
'Topological_sort.cpp':('REINSIRK_TOPOLOGICAL_CORE_DEFINED',None,['ReinsirkTopologicalRun']),
}
records=[]
for name,(guard,public_marker,symbols) in configs.items():
 path=root/name
 before=path.read_text(); (out/name).write_text(before)
 mapping={s:s.removeprefix('Reinsirk') for s in symbols}
 text=before
 for old,new in mapping.items(): text=re.sub(r'\b'+old+r'\b',new,text)
 opening='#define '+guard+'\n'
 assert text.count(opening)==1
 text=text.replace(opening,opening+'namespace reinsirk::detail {\n',1)
 if public_marker is None:
  closing='}\n#endif\n\n#ifndef REINSIRK_TOPOLOGICAL_SORT_DEFINED'
  assert closing in text
  text=text.replace(closing,'}\n} // namespace reinsirk::detail\n#endif\n\n#ifndef REINSIRK_TOPOLOGICAL_SORT_DEFINED',1)
  start=text.index('#ifndef REINSIRK_TOPOLOGICAL_SORT_DEFINED')
 else:
  start=text.index(public_marker)
  text=text[:start]+'} // namespace reinsirk::detail\n\n'+text[start:]
  start=text.index(public_marker)
 internal=text[:start]; public=text[start:]
 for new in mapping.values(): public=re.sub(r'\b'+new+r'\b','reinsirk::detail::'+new,public)
 text=internal+public
 path.write_text(text)
 # Reconstruct exact input after removing namespace and qualifications, reversing the renames.
 reconstructed=text.replace('namespace reinsirk::detail {\n','').replace('} // namespace reinsirk::detail\n','').replace('reinsirk::detail::','')
 if public_marker is not None: reconstructed=reconstructed.replace('\n\n'+public_marker,'\n'+public_marker,1)
 for old,new in mapping.items(): reconstructed=re.sub(r'\b'+new+r'\b',old,reconstructed)
 assert reconstructed==before, name
 records.append({'file':str(path),'before_sha256':hashlib.sha256(before.encode()).hexdigest(),'after_sha256':hashlib.sha256(text.encode()).hexdigest(),'mapping':mapping,'internal_namespace':'reinsirk::detail','exact_reverse_transform_matches':True})
(out/'manifest.json').write_text(json.dumps(records,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps(records,indent=2))
